info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-billing-dotnet-api-Delete Api Shipment By Shipment Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Shipment Management API provides functionalities for managing shipments within the billing service. This specific operation allows users to remove a shipment entry identified by its unique shipment ID. It is primarily intended for services that need to maintain accurate shipping records by enabling the deletion of outdated or incorrect shipments. Typical consumers include logistics teams and application developers who integrate shipment functionalities into their systems.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a shipment identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that the shipment is no longer required before deletion, as this action cannot be undone.
